receipt_rules.reference_model_content: Use exact deterministic fixture output where reference supports a real configured provider; otherwise score an explicitly frozen outcome predicate and retain transcript, never replace reference with a mock.
receipt_rules.missing_reference: BLOCKED_REFERENCE; no pass or denominator reduction
receipt_rules.reference_mutation: New capture identity/version or changed service invalidates affected receipts
receipt_rules.normalization: No text paraphrase, sorting, filtering, payload removal, or tenant/effect/budget rewriting. Namespaces preserve identity relationships.
receipt_rules.negative_evaluation: Reference negative outcomes are compared only for documented product behavior. Additional CVG denials use approved CVG SPEC; not assumed Claude behavior.

protocols.name: HOOKS
fixture_steps: session start/end; READ success; tool failure; subagent end; compaction
observations: append-only marker file: event, tool, parent, ordinal, exit; raw stdout/stderr
adversaries: wrong matcher; duplicate event; nonzero handler; timeout; handler attempts to grant denied WRITE

protocols.name: CHILDREN
fixture_steps: parent alpha forks named child beta; explicit tools/model/effort; child returns marker child-result-17; resume after process restart
observations: parent/child identity graph, transcripts, calls, cost, process exit
adversaries: foreign parent; widening tools; fanout/depth+1; duplicate child message; cancel while waiting

protocols.name: SESSIONS
fixture_steps: alpha/beta workspaces with two named synthetic sessions; new process resumes alpha by ID; fork and inspect original; no-persist; retention
observations: session identity/lineage, transcript marker alpha-17, disk inventory before/after; new process capture
adversaries: wrong workspace/identity; expired session; mutate fork then read original; attempt no-persist resume

protocols.name: MCP
protocols.boundary: public MCP client and host server protocol
fixture_steps: owned stdio + loopback HTTP fixture; echo marker mcp-17; discover tool schema; resource/prompt; request human input
observations: wire messages, handshake/version, tool list/schema, config origins, effect count; server transcript
adversaries: strict-config with ambient server; wrong schema/version; expired auth; denied tool; input EOF; oversized resource; redirect/egress

protocols.name: EXTENSIONS
fixture_steps: two synthetic plugin versions; SKILL.md with description and delayed reference marker; enable v1; invoke; upgrade while turn in progress
observations: loaded files/context bytes by stage, selected version, dependency graph, active generation, effective configuration
adversaries: duplicate/invalid manifest; path escape; missing grant; dependency cycle; update/remove with live reference

protocols.name: CONTEXT_MEMORY
fixture_steps: numbered transcript with fact ticket-17 and approval pending; large READ; compact; project/user instructions with origins; learn/inspect/revise/delete memory; disable
observations: raw transcript retained, selected facts/pending approvals, measured input/context, memory files/store before/after per workspace
adversaries: conflicting instructions; wrong workspace; expired/deleted memory; hidden learn when disabled; prune hides error/approval

protocols.name: PROGRAMMATIC
fixture_steps: prompt marker output-17; text/json/stream-json; JSON schema; chunked model; reconnect cursor; host input and approval dialogue
observations: raw bytes/chunk boundaries, event ordering, terminal count, parsed JSON/schema, effect journal
adversaries: invalid schema/input; duplicated replay; EOF/cancel; missing terminal; bad cursor; slow reader; unauthenticated approval

protocols.name: PLANNING
protocols.boundary: plan-mode session and visible plan/todo boundary
fixture_steps: read source marker plan-17; publish plan with two todos; revise; restart; explicitly enter execution after authorized review
observations: effective tools/mode, plan revision, todo owner/state, transcript and effects before/after transition
adversaries: WRITE in plan; forged completion; mode lost on resume; plan approval used as effect grant

protocols.name: CONTAINMENT
protocols.boundary: host containment probe + public tool execution
fixture_steps: owned scratch roots allowed/denied; loopback allowlisted/denied targets; finite child with explicit env; resource probes
observations: actual syscalls/backend availability, exit/status, process tree and /proc after termination, files/network hits and limits
adversaries: outside-root symlink/hardlink/traversal; undeclared env; missing sandbox; child survives cancel; bounded output/CPU/memory/pids probes

protocols.name: BUDGET_MODELS
protocols.boundary: session model selection and cost accounting
fixture_steps: deterministic metered provider fixture; parent + two children reserve 7 from total 10; explicit effort/model; primary failure then approved fallback; restart/cancel
observations: request model/effort, attempts, budget reservation/settlement ledger, stop reason and aggregate charge
adversaries: double reservation; unknown cost; retry loses first error; unapproved fallback; cancel refunds spent cost; stale settlement

protocols.name: BACKGROUND
fixture_steps: owned alpha job emits marker bg-17 then waits; second process lists/attaches; respawn; stop; remove only owned clean worktree
observations: job/session/process identities across attach/restart, logs, input delivery, process tree, workspace diff
adversaries: cross-workspace attach; read-only observer writes; duplicate wake; stale owner; foreign worktree/dirty cleanup

protocols.name: WORKSPACES
fixture_steps: temporary synthetic Git repo with base file owner-17; grant extra root; create task branch/worktree; terminal echo; recover; cleanup
observations: canonical roots, branch/path/owner, Git status, terminal capability/process exit and recovery metadata
adversaries: ungranted root; path alias; foreign/dirty worktree; missing owner metadata; terminal unavailable; stale cleanup

protocols.name: REWIND
fixture_steps: edit owned file A to B; append conversation C; independently restore code/conversation/both; directed summary; expire snapshot
observations: content digests and transcript lineage before/after, snapshot owner/turn/retention, conflict report
adversaries: third-party B-to-D edit; outside root; stale snapshot; shell/child/external effect outside undo coverage

protocols.name: CONFIGURATION
fixture_steps: distinct user/project/local/managed markers; inspect precedence; safe/bare; authorized prompt replace/append; resume frozen request
observations: effective origin/value list with secrets redacted, prompt/model/config digests and request bytes
adversaries: unknown settings; managed control override; secret sentinel in dump; ambient config in bare; changed config reuses stale receipt

protocols.name: EVALS
protocols.boundary: extension eval runner and local report
fixture_steps: two-case synthetic suite, two repetitions, plugin enabled/disabled on same fixtures; local mocked model with budget and threshold
observations: suite/grader/plugin/model digests, per-case score/cost/latency/context, ordering and exit status
adversaries: threshold fail; overspend; duplicate case; changed grader/model/fixture; high quality but failed control; unintended network

protocols.name: REMOTE
fixture_steps: authorized synthetic account/workspace; create cloud identity; attach; named self-hosted env; pair remote client; IDE stream/diff; desktop handoff; validated gateway
observations: service build/date/plan/region and client digest, connection/workspace/session identity, consent/revocation, raw request/event receipts and effects
adversaries: wrong/expired client; revoke then replay; wrong workspace; forged IDE approval; invalid gateway config/auth; disconnect during effect
